title: Try my new AI game!!! Free on tavamadethis.com
author: Spirited_Carpet5109
selftext:
Hello AI game devs, ive just got into vibecoding with claude and made my first sandbox game with a website. its basically just a dumb lil destruction sandbox game with some pretty cool features i'll list below. I got 3 maps - San Diego (Gaslamp), La Playa, and Chicago. The game works on both desktop and mobile phone, you can even click share and "add to homescreen" to turn it into an app on your phone. Someone please try it out its pretty fun especially on a computer. Click the "Rick and Morty" button, and turn on the radio with "P" key to vibe. [tavamadethis.com](http://tavamadethis.com/)

My workflow: claude code pro, then I type as many ideas as possible into chatgpt, then I have chat orginize a good prompt for claude, paste into claude while making small changes along the way, add good refrences images for specific things, add real SFX from epidemic sound, add GTA5 NPC dialog for realism.

* Rick and Morty ship you can fly around in
* Rick and Morty characters with real dialogue
* Rick’s ship has its own flight mechanics
* Chucky the rapper appears in Summer Smash
* Summer Smash map
* Latino music playing around La Playa
* La Playa news is entirely in Spanish
* GTA 5 NPC voice dialogue used for NPCs
* Real human NPC voices instead of robotic AI voices
* Real sound effects throughout the game
* World button for spawning different things into the map
* Chicago gang wars happening throughout the city
* Police stations on every map
* Different police responses depending on what happens
* NPCs react to things happening around them
* NPCs can fight each other
* NPCs can get involved in gang wars
* Cars and pedestrians populate the maps
* Multiple different maps/worlds to explore
* La Playa has its own Latino/Spanish atmosphere
* Chicago has its own gang/police atmosphere
* Summer Smash has its own festival atmosphere
* Different music depending on the map
* Random NPC conversations happening around the world
* Environmental sounds are recorded/realistic rather than generic placeholders
* Vehicles have their own sounds
* Police vehicles and emergency activity
* Lots of little references and easter eggs hidden around the maps
* Interactive world-spawning system lets you experiment with the environment
* You can create your own chaos instead of following a fixed mission
* Different maps have completely different themes and atmospheres
* Tiny details hidden throughout the environments
* Characters and locations inspired by things from real life and pop culture
* The game mixes realistic environments with completely ridiculous situations
